integrity: Self-contained mathematical derivation with direct finite enumeration corroboration. Primary sources and adjacent published mathematical records compared by implication; originality is assessed on the bivariate binary shortest-absent-subsequence interpretation, not on a pre-existing scalar sequence. Independent external scientific audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ambient binary alphabet; sum over all source words, not variance or typical concentration; uniform-only asymptotic; no extension to larger alphabets. One-dimensional sequence coincides with OEIS A087955 after an index shift, so numerical recurrence itself is not claimed as independently novel. Unindexed equivalent bivariate weighted transfer formulas remain a potential prior-art risk.
title: Exact mean and universality-index distribution of shortest absent subsequences in binary words
